name: sprout-payroll
description: Work with Sprout payroll — one-time external adjustments, overtime rates, payroll runs, approved payroll per employee, and report downloads (payroll summary, payslip PDF, BIR Form 2316).

connection.instructions:
Connect with your Sprout API credentials. Request API access from the **Sprout Developer Portal** (Getting Started → Authorization) to receive your **Client ID** and **Client Secret**.

1. In the Sprout Developer Portal, request API access and accept the terms.
2. Once approved, copy your **Client ID** and **Client Secret**.
3. For **production** access, also paste the **Subscription Key** (`Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key`) Sprout issues, and your **Tenant Code** (your company code). Both can be left blank for the sandbox.

We exchange your client id/secret for a short-lived token automatically — you never paste a bearer token.

fields.name: SPROUT_CLIENT_ID
fields.label: Client ID
fields.helpText: Issued by Sprout when your API access is approved.

fields.name: SPROUT_CLIENT_SECRET
fields.label: Client Secret
fields.helpText: Issued alongside your Client ID. Stored encrypted; exchanged server-side for a token.

fields.name: SPROUT_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY
fields.label: Subscription Key (production only)
fields.helpText: Required for production (Azure API Management). Leave blank for the sandbox.

fields.name: SPROUT_TENANT_CODE
fields.label: Tenant Code
fields.helpText: Identifies which company the calls target. Leave blank if your client is single-tenant.
